assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production front-elevation diffuse texture atlas for 3D buildings in a realistic original driving game set in southern Brazil. One wide landscape bitmap, divided into exactly FOUR equally wide vertical bays that touch at x=25%, 50%, 75%. Each bay is a separate flat wall of a two-storey property, 7.0 metres wide and 6.8 metres tall, so fill its vertical cell entirely with its front wall, from sidewalk sill at the very bottom to straight roof parapet at the very top. Camera dead straight, architectural orthographic elevation, zero perspective convergence. Full bleed wall texture: no sky, side walls, street or floor plane anywhere, no angles. L→R: 1) small 1970s corner bakery, off-white aged lime plaster with faint hairline cracking, lower muted moss green painted surround with aluminum shop window and glass door revealing warm shelves, upper story has two simple old aluminum windows, exposed rough dark base; 2) ochre-gray two-storey Brazilian auto electrical shop, narrow dark entry, large worn charcoal galvanized roller shutter, rough faded horizontal cream shop sign band, upstairs industrial square windows; 3) pale concrete grey-brown residential building with a slender entry to left, dark perforated steel double garage gate downstairs and three dark aluminum-framed windows with curtains upstairs, simple mosaic base; 4) muted pale warm gray small hardware store, recessed tarnished aluminium mullions with visual shelves, one dark roller shutter, upstairs two small separate rectangular windows and vents. No human figures, cars, foliage, logos, awnings, painted letters, typography or decorative dividers. Quiet real Brazilian main street, genuine photo microtexture, humidity staining at joints, subtle occlusion inside the window openings, uneven field repairs. Diffuse neutral cloudy-day light, flat even exposure and restrained colors. Game texture, not concept art. Use a wide 3:1 aspect ratio if available.

assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: physically plausible, seamless base-color texture for the 3D street environment of the original driving game Wave. assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original single production foliage cutout texture for the alpha-scissored leaf cards of a 3D jabuticaba tree in an original Brazilian driving game. Generate one isolated nearly square broad spreading branch tip of Plinia cauliflora, seen straight-on, filling 90 percent of a square canvas with a margin. Actual transparent RGBA background, including clearly open irregular gaps through the foliage, no grey backdrop. 45–65 individually readable small oval lanceolate glossy leaves, layered in loosely connected slender twigs, natural irregular asymmetrical branching, broader spread up-left and right from a fine central stem. Matte diffuse albedo under neutral overcast daylight, fresh medium olive and sage greens with very subtle younger copper-green leaves, controlled luminosity in the shadowed leaves, fine natural leaf veins. Leaf faces show varying orientation but no bright baked highlights, hard shadows, ground, decorative border, trunk, fruit, lettering, watermark, or text. Bold enough leafy silhouette to survive mipmapping. No separate clippings, assemble a single connected spray.
